প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ: ১২ আষাঢ়, ১৪৩১ বঙ্গাব্দ/২৬ জুন, ২০২৪ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ

Customs Act 2023: Section 25(1) of this Act empowers the Government to issue notifications regarding customs-related amendments in the public interest.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to amend regulatory orders in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Government consults with this body before exercising its powers to issue or amend regulatory orders under the customs and taxation acts.
S.R.O. 176-AIN/2024: This existing notification is formally amended by the current order to adjust H.S. Codes and associated entries for specific chemical and pharmaceutical products listed in its table.
H.S. Code: The table within the notification is amended to replace existing codes with new ones, delete specific entries, and insert new classification headings for products such as chemical derivatives and oils.
TABLE: The table within the notification is updated to rectify H.S. Codes for specified items, remove obsolete entries, and add new product descriptions such as Polyoxyl 40 Hydrogenated Castor oil under heading 34.02.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ২। এই প্রজ্ঞাপন ৬ জুন, ২০২৪ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ তারিখে কার্যকর হইয়াছে বলিয়া গণ্য হইবে।

Statutory Regulatory Order: This order is deemed to have come into effect on a specific date in June two thousand twenty-four.
